summary:
Reviewed 4ebe93b (w115): measure now names only the run whose session.json is empty, pairing a stage's run directories, ordered by k, with its ended starts. Nothing under features/ changed. No test was removed or weakened; one new script test file was added. tools check and size are clean.
The one Important finding is an observation: with an empty session.json on an unended start, or when the run-directory and ended-start counts differ, nothing is named (r57). work run does not produce either shape today; reproduced with .shop/scratch/w115-4-review/probe_open.py.
One Minor finding is dropped: non-<k>-<stage> directories are skipped.
